statement: The convergence-probe class (test/shards/convergence-probes.txt, 3 files) is bounded-time convergence: statistical and hardware-relative, never a per-run gate (decision 6fcb63299). That decision was half implemented: test:all excluded the class, but the change-proof planner still selected its files by observation, so every land touching transport-messaging, bootstrap-membership or cdc-metadata ran them (346 s red per run on 2026-09-17) while no CI corpus ever did. Now the planner leaves the class out by name and records what it left out (plan.observedElsewhere, the explain section and the summary line), a spine test is never left out whatever its class, and the full-corpus canary gains a non-gating step that runs npm run test:convergence-probes so the probes are finally observed. The multi-join probe was already re-expressed for the runtime-owned endpoint contract (2c4f26d36).

constraints.statement: Every probe the selector wanted is named in the plan as observed elsewhere with the reason it would have run for; the summary line and --explain print the count and the paths.
A safety-spine test is never left out of a proof whatever its class.
The canary step runs the class with continue-on-error and if: always(); it never fails the workflow and never becomes a push-gate lane.
Only existing files are edited: the planner, its test, the canary workflow.
